title: Beautiful but I hate them. Sending back
text: Beautiful but I hate them. Sending back. These are beautiful items but I really dislike the latch system. You must lift from the side tab but to latch and unlatch takes both hands, a sturdy counter top and a lot of hand/arm  pressure. My life is too busy to go through this just to latch or unlatch a canister. My husband said they weren’t too bad but difficult and he still thought they weren’t efficient  I’ve had a set of click clacks for at least 15 years that are simple and easy to use and have a wide mouth. They aren’t as clear and beautiful as these, probably aren’t as airtight or waterproof, but I’ve never dropped them in a sink of water, have no need to  microwave them, and I’ve never had bugs. So, I’ll keep looking for a replacement or just stick with my old set.
